challenges.title: Send your first transactional email
challenges.blurb: Wire up Resend and send a real transactional email from your own code.
steps: Create a free account at resend.com and grab an API key.
Install the SDK:  npm i resend
Send an email to the verification address shown by `bounty earn resend-first-email --start`.
Run `bounty verify resend-first-email --proof <message-id>` with the id Resend returns.
challenges.proofLabel: Resend message id (from the API response)

challenges.title: Create a test-mode PaymentIntent
challenges.blurb: Spin up a test-mode charge and confirm it resolves.
steps: Create a Stripe account, stay in test mode.
Create a PaymentIntent with the test card 4242 4242 4242 4242.

challenges.title: Query an edge database
challenges.blurb: Create a libSQL database and run a query against it from local code.
steps: Install the Turso CLI and create a database.
Run a SELECT from a Node script using @libsql/client.
